note: Year one, no bidding history in this league yet -- bid is unpriced throughout. 14 teams on 100 FAAB chase the thinnest pool of the three leagues, so HBGBs prices would read low here. My own roster is RB-heavy (seven backs) but dangerously thin at WR (three total, two in FLEX are backs) -- full PPR makes that worse, not better, so both WR pursuits (Robinson, Hollins) matter more here than the identical names would in the other two leagues.

targets.my_team_impact: You own only three wide receivers total -- Robinson is a direct roster fix, not a luxury, in a format that punishes going light at WR.
targets.confidence_why: One quiet Week 1 with two locked starters ahead of him caps this at a depth add, not a confident starter bet.
targets.competition: nashsmom (Evans) and haleymegert (Samuel) both start ahead of him and aren't acutely needy at WR.
